name: Torek's Assault
summary: From Ashenvale's wilds, Torek's Assault strikes Silverwing Outpost. Under orders from Splintertree Post, the orc raider Torek leads a brazen, bloody skirmish to crush Sentinel resistance and slay their commander, Duriel Moonfire, in the war for Ashenvale's borders.

sections.title: A Strike from the Shadows
sections.body: The Horde's lumber camps and the native night elves are locked in an escalating border war across Ashenvale. Torek gathers a pack of Splintertree raiders just outside Silverwing Outpost to break the Alliance's defensive perimeter. He leads a head-on charge before the night elves can counterattack or mount a reinforced campaign against Splintertree Post.

sections.title: Taking Silverwing
sections.body: Silverwing Outpost is a fortified woodland garrison held by vigilant Silverwing Sentinels and fierce elven warriors. Torek targets their leader, Duriel Moonfire. Bringing Duriel down decapitates the local night elf military hierarchy, allowing the raiders to report a bloody victory to their commander, Ertog Ragetusk, at Splintertree Post.

faq.answer: Torek is an aggressive orc raider based at Splintertree Post in Ashenvale. Fierce and hungry for battle, he commands a detachment tasked with taking the fight directly to the night elf forces in the forest.
Silverwing Outpost is a fortified night elf settlement in Ashenvale. Elite Sentinels and warriors guard it as a military bulwark watching Horde troop movements along the woodland trails.

Duriel Moonfire is the night elf commander defending Silverwing Outpost. As head of the garrison, she directs the local Sentinels against Horde incursions until Torek's raiding party breaches the camp and strikes her down.
Ertog Ragetusk is a Horde officer stationed at Splintertree Post. He is Torek's superior, oversees military operations in the region, and receives reports of victories against the Alliance.

faq.q: Why does the Horde attack Silverwing Outpost?
faq.answer: The Horde and night elves are engaged in active territorial warfare across Ashenvale. The strike on Silverwing Outpost relieves pressure on Horde supply lines and weakens the Sentinel defenses guarding the deeper forest.

faq.q: Where does this attack take place?
faq.answer: The assault begins just outside Silverwing Outpost, on the eastern, Horde-held side of the Falfarren River in Ashenvale. It ends inside the night elf encampment.

angles.text: For the Horde, pushing past Silverwing Outpost tests their strength and weakens the night elf blockade around Splintertree Post.
Duriel Moonfire's fall exposes Silverwing Outpost and threatens the night elves' ancestral woodland holdings.
A brutal frontal melee tests your endurance against seasoned Sentinel archers and blademasters.
The raid strikes the Sentinels' frontline command, spilling elven blood beneath Ashenvale's boughs.
